subject.title: feat: add Codex session MCP profile

question: Should OpenClaw ship this Codex-specific CLI profile and experimental native sidebar-collection metadata now, provided the import cycle is fixed and the global MCP App fallback remains available?
rationale: The core projection is technically coherent, but the permanent public CLI surface and metadata for a Codex capability absent from open-source Codex require explicit product ownership rather than reviewer inference.

options.title: Approve guarded fallback
options.body: Accept the Codex-specific profile, require the cycle fix and live proof, and keep native sidebar metadata additive behind the global app fallback.

options.title: Ship global app only
options.body: Accept the session tools and global app resource now but defer native sidebar metadata until its Codex contract is publicly inspectable and testable.

options.title: Defer integration
options.body: Pause this PR and the stacked UI PR until Codex exposes a stable first-class collection contract.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded fallback
recommendation.body: Accept the Codex-specific profile, require the cycle fix and live proof, and keep native sidebar metadata additive behind the global app fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The behavior traces to their original MCP bridge ownership, and the protected maintainer label requires explicit product handling.
